nativeValidation.setup: Run the commands in Bash from a clean disposable checkout at the stated revision using the repository Go toolchain and macOS command-line tools. Stop if any command fails.
commands: test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 'd2f9ed0b2ee7e36e519b275dc2688895c3b7a05a' && sw_vers && go version

env -u OWNSAND_AGENT_STATE_DIR -u OWNSAND_AGENT_API_URL -u OWNSAND_AGENT_RUNTIME -u OWNSAND_AGENT_GUEST_BINARY -u OWNSAND_AGENT_RELEASE_MANIFEST_URL -u OWNSAND_AGENT_RELEASE_PUBLIC_KEYS -u OWNSAND_AGENT_LOG_LEVEL -u OWNSAND_AGENT_FIRECRACKER_BINARY -u OWNSAND_AGENT_LINUX_KERNEL -u OWNSAND_AGENT_LINUX_ROOTFS TMPDIR="$(pwd)/.t3-tmp/service-state/ordinary" CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -mod=readonly -count=1 -json ./cmds/ownsand-agent -run '^(TestCLIMisc|TestServiceDefinitionUsesTheExplicitStateDir)$' > '.t3-tmp/service-state/macos-clean.jsonl'

env -u OWNSAND_AGENT_STATE_DIR -u OWNSAND_AGENT_API_URL -u OWNSAND_AGENT_RUNTIME -u OWNSAND_AGENT_GUEST_BINARY -u OWNSAND_AGENT_RELEASE_MANIFEST_URL -u OWNSAND_AGENT_RELEASE_PUBLIC_KEYS -u OWNSAND_AGENT_LOG_LEVEL -u OWNSAND_AGENT_FIRECRACKER_BINARY -u OWNSAND_AGENT_LINUX_KERNEL -u OWNSAND_AGENT_LINUX_ROOTFS TMPDIR="$(pwd)/.t3-tmp/service-state/ampersand&tmp" CGO_ENABLED=1 OWNSAND_AGENT_GUEST_BINARY='/var/lib/from-env/ownsand-guest' go test -mod=readonly -count=1 -json ./cmds/ownsand-agent -run '^(TestCLIMisc|TestServiceDefinitionUsesTheExplicitStateDir)$' > '.t3-tmp/service-state/macos-collision.jsonl'
expectedResults: Both go test commands exit 0. Neither focused fixture skips.
TestCLIMisc passes the explicit and fallback subtests for ordinary paths and for paths containing an ampersand. Both assert the decoded value under EnvironmentVariables.

TestServiceDefinitionUsesTheExplicitStateDir checks the guest-binary entry and the exact state-directory entry in both positive renders. The missing-state and wrong-state controls reject both expected values while the guest-binary entry remains present.

windows.setup: Run the commands in PowerShell from a short, clean disposable checkout at the stated revision using the repository Go toolchain.
commands: if ((git rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne 'd2f9ed0b2ee7e36e519b275dc2688895c3b7a05a') { throw 'Unexpected checkout revision' }; go version

go test -mod=readonly -count=1 -json ./cmds/ownsand-agent -run '^TestCLIMisc$' > '.t3-tmp\service-state\windows.jsonl'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Get-Content '.t3-tmp\service-state\windows.jsonl'; throw 'Windows fixture failed' }
expectedResults: Its ordinary explicit and fallback subtests compare the exact OWNSAND_AGENT_STATE_DIR assignment in the printed REG_MULTI_SZ data.
